# Cell Biology

## Introduction

Cells are the fundamental units of living organisms.

In this chapter, we will explore how cells are organized,
how their structures relate to their functions, and how
cells interact with their environments.

## Learning objectives

By the end of this chapter, you should be able to:

- explain the basic principles of cell theory
- distinguish between prokaryotic and eukaryotic cells
- identify major cellular structures
- relate cellular structures to their functions

## Why cells matter

All organisms are made of one or more cells.

Although cells can differ enormously in size, shape, and
function, they share important characteristics.

Understanding cells provides a foundation for understanding
many other areas of biology.
